policy.first_slice: static asset import and replace/reimport through the real factory

selection_evidence.profile: CarlaUnrealEditor Linux Development -architecture=arm64, explicit FBX headers-only diagnostic
selection_evidence.boundary: Evaluated diagnostic selection, not a successfully linked default Editor or a complete C++ call graph.

acceptance: ImportAssets with FbxFactory creates saved UStaticMesh assets at the requested package paths.
Verify units, axes, mirrored winding, hierarchy, normals, UVs and separate/combined mesh settings after reload.

fixture_gaps: External texture and material shading reference scene
acceptance: Create actual material/texture assets and validate slot identity, instance overrides, UV binding and name conflicts.
Compare shading and persisted material assignments; material UID nodes alone are insufficient.

fixture_gaps: UCX/UBX/USP collision and SOCKET_ hierarchy, including reimport removal
acceptance: Verify generated/custom collision and socket transforms on the actual UStaticMesh.
Reimport preserves user-created sockets and removes obsolete imported sockets without corrupting collision.
Import and reimport every requested LOD with correct section/material mapping and screen-size settings.
Validate bind poses, skin weights, skeleton identity, sampled animation and morph deltas on actual assets.
Verify negative/nonzero animation start times, frame rates, curve interpolation and reimport identity.

fixture_gaps: CARLA tiled map with known origins and adjacent boundaries
acceptance: Exercise bReplaceExisting, source identity, settings, materials and user-edited asset state across repeated imports.
Preserve CARLA bForceVerticesRelativeToTile and TileSize behavior, package naming and map placement.
Malformed input must not partially overwrite an existing asset.

fixture_gaps: Saved UE sequence with cameras, lights, skeletal tracks and independent FBX round-trip expectations
acceptance: Verify exported transforms, cameras, materials, skeletons and animation through an independent reader; object compilation does not establish export parity.

fixture_gaps: Road/sidewalk/crosswalk FBX and expected OBJ/navigation geometry
acceptance: Trace whether the selected map build invokes FBX2OBJ and provide a native replacement when it does.
Do not classify this CARLA-side SDK consumer as absent merely because it is outside the UE lexical inventory.
